**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **What the document has:** Section 9 ("TRUELINK WARRANTIES", p0059–p0060) is limited entirely to Year 2000 date handling. Section 3's response-time provision (p0032) is only a reasonable-commercial-efforts covenant, and Section 12 (p0076) disclaims all implied warranties, including fitness and merchantability, and any warranty as to data accuracy/completeness.
- **Gap:** No professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface or related software, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty (only Client gives one, at p0056), and no repair/replace/refund remedy.
- **Direction check:** Section 8 obligations run against us and were left untouched; the inserted warranty binds TrueLink only. The disclaimer's existing "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT" opener already preserves express warranties, so no edit to p0076 was needed — keeping the redline to a single insertion.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** New paragraph after p0060 giving a 12-month software conformance warranty, 90-day services warranty, compliance with laws, no malicious code, and re-performance/repair/replacement/refund as our remedy, with the 90/30-day fallback offered in the comment.
